# v6.8.0

- `Feature` files.batchRename in [Files](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/files?id=m-batchrename), covering batch renaming provided by the Batch Rename plugin: plan preview and per-item exclusion, applying, undo, querying and clearing the batch history, name previews without files, named presets, options and replacement variables (counters, date and time, random values, photo metadata, Chinese to pinyin), conflict policies, result objects and error codes
- `Feature` [Gallery](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/gallery) and [GalleryViewSession](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/galleryViewSessionType), covering picking, viewer sessions, editing and headless conversion provided by the 3-Maple Image plugin, the boundary that AutoJs6 reads and writes the files itself, photo access and error codes
- `Update` [API reference](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/documentation) covers missing Files and RootAutomator members, color result arrays, WebView contexts and optional overloads, and corrects byte append, swipe parameters and coordinate scaling descriptions; explains that failed setScaleBases calls neither change nor consume scale bases, and documents integer conversion by the base setters
- `Feature` [3-Block Compose Designer](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/composeDesigner), covering the visual designer built into the 3-Block Compose plugin: its entries and project files, the editor's canvas / outline / properties / component palette and drafts, the recognized script subset and round-trip rules, the two-way hand-over with the AutoJs6 editor, and current limitations
- `Update` The "Comparison mode" section in [AutoJs4 Runtime](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/autojs4Runtime) explains the two runs performed by "Run with AutoJs4 and compare", result summaries and difference markers, and copying the issue template
- `Feature` [AutoJs4 Runtime](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/autojs4Runtime), covering the AutoJs4 Runtime plugin's purpose, installation and permissions, the file manager's "Run with AutoJs4" entry, returned logs, stopping tasks, execution limits and reporting differences
- `Update` The getAndroidId(useSystemId) overload in [Device](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/device) explains retrieving the system value for the running app's Android user through Shizuku/Root, exceptions on failure and ignoring the argument before Android 8.0
- `Feature` [Terminal](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/terminal), [TerminalSession](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/terminalSessionType), [TerminalOpenOptions](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/terminalOpenOptionsType) and [TerminalError](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/terminalErrorType), covering the 3-Shell Terminal plugin dependency, synchronous and asynchronous session management, output events, npm scripts, permissions and lifecycle
- `Feature` OKLab / OKLCH conversions (oklab, oklch, toOklab, toOklch), ensureContrast, harmony, tones, derive, nightVariant, simulate and extract in [Color](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/color), and the `oklab` algorithm in [ColorDetectionAlgorithm](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/dataTypes?id=colordetectionalgorithm)
- `Feature` The colors.theme theme-color controls (get, set, reset, libraries, activate, deactivate, next, state, current) in [Color](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/color) explain merging script changes, history sources and undo, plus the smart palette's "Script state" source and "Script start" group-switch timing

###### 2026/10/05

- `Update` Advanced installation options in [Installer](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/installer), the optimizing phase and observations of ownership/manual compilation, with local signature checks, package/shared UID blocklists and permission-preview boundaries for selected splits
- `Update` Persistent-default boundaries in [Installer](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/installer): Dhizuku API 26-33, Root's separate system identity and user 0, mode-specific automatic grants, local configuration receipts and unconfirmed-write semantics
- `Update` The mcp tool group in the AI Agent 1.2.0 development version, disabled by default, server configuration and tool selection, per-server risks and remote-cancellation boundaries
- `Update` The script_dynamic tool group in the AI Agent 1.1.0 development version, disabled by default, separate confirmation for each source, private step records and the workflow for saving registered scripts
- `Update` Android, host-build and 3-Stone AI model requirements for AI Agent 1.0.0, distinguishing plugin attachment from the complete task API, model availability and current observation capabilities
- `Update` Global settings and budget merging in AI Agent build 60, distinguishing initial defaults from protocol hard limits, with tool groups and cautious mode only further restricted by presets and per-call parameters
- `Feature` Documentation for [EPUB](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/epub), [EpubBook](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/epubBookType), [EpubReaderSession](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/epubReaderSessionType) and [EpubLocator](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/epubLocatorType), covering the Readium EPUB Reader plugin's metadata, table of contents, text extraction, cover/resource export, full-text search, reader-session events and control, reading preferences, location objects and error codes
- `Update` Highlights and notes in [EPUB](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/epub): [EpubBook#annotations](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/epubBookType?id=m-annotations) and the `epub.annotations` convenience layer read annotations saved by the reader for a book (Readium EPUB Reader plugin 1.1.0, EPUB contract version 2); [EpubReaderSession](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/epubReaderSessionType) gains the `highlight` event (`action`: `added` / `updated` / `removed`), with corresponding carried-location additions to [EpubLocator](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/epubLocatorType)
- `Feature` Documentation for [Mail](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/mail), [MailClient](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/mailClientType), [MailMessage](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/mailMessageType), [MailAccountOptions](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/mailAccountOptionsType) and [MailSearchQuery](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/mailSearchQueryType), covering the Angus Mail plugin's IMAP / POP3 / SMTP sending and receiving, search, attachments, flags, folders, new-mail listeners, account options, provider presets and error codes
- `Update` A "Run a script when mail arrives" example in [Mail](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/mail): background watchers in Angus Mail plugin 1.1.0 and AutoJs6's "When mail arrives" scheduled task (mail contract version 2); scripts read the watcher name, account alias, folder, envelope and arrival time through `engines.myEngine().execArgv.mail`
- `Update` An optional `oauth` object for `mail.accounts.list()` in [Mail](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/mail): sign-in state (`provider`, `authorizedAt`, `expiresAt`, `needsReauth`) of accounts signed into Google / Microsoft through the browser in Angus Mail plugin 1.2.0 settings; tokens themselves are excluded
- `Update` Flow coordinate-click methods, unlimited attempts when maxAttempts is the default 0, and task call stacks and console output for exceptions
- `Update` Flow optional steps `whenPresent`, bounded loops `repeatUntil`, chained candidate search/click, collection stability and `snapshot` options, with the default `stableFor` corrected to 0
- `Feature` Documentation for [Pangu](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/pangu), covering global objects, text layout, spacing checks and runtime environments of built-in pangu.js 10.1.0
- `Update` The request scope of `isInsecure` / `insecure` in [HTTP](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/http) and [HttpRequestBuilderOptions](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/httpRequestBuilderOptionsType), shared-client configuration and distinctions between certificate trust, CT, ECH and local-network permission
- `Update` Android 17 background-audio requirements in [Media](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/media), [Device](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/device), [TTS](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/tts) and [Settings](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/settings), silent suppression, recovery through visible UI and engine-process boundaries
- `Fix` The offline synchronizer overwriting the plugin's independent release version with the documentation content version; preserve the plugin version while continuing to check contentVersion and provenance
- `Update` Local-network permission names in [Runtime](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/runtime), Android 17 / targetSdk 37 conditions, asynchronous authorization and retry, and native Socket / MQTT and plugin permission boundaries
- `Feature` The read-only `pageSize` property in [Device](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/device), returning the current system page size in bytes, with 4 KB / 16 KB examples
- `Update` Dynamic automatic selection in [OCR](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ocr), hot switching as plugins start/stop, mode/tap reset rules and per-call options
- `Update` streamNumber multi-stream queries, countGet stream counts, infoKind unit/description queries, capability negotiation and the original-path semantics of Complete name in [MediaInfo](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/mediainfo)
- `Feature` Documentation for [Flow](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/flow), [Flow](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/flowType) and [FlowError](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/flowErrorType), covering asynchronous waits and action chains, global entry functions, wait options and error objects
- `Feature` Tools (smartClick, clickIfExists, clickAny, findAny, scrollUntil, typeInto, dismissPopups, collectList, launchAndWait, backUntil, backToApp, toggle, retry), event-driven waits (waitForIdle, waitForEvent, waitForToast, waitForNotification) and auto's wait, findWindows, findWindowRoots, explain, dump, stats in [Automator](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/automator)
- `Feature` select(syntax) string-selector syntax, find(max) and findIterator in [UiSelector](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/uiSelectorType); isStale, waitUntilGone, waitForStable, fingerprint, toJSON, dumpSubtree, contentInvalid, contextClickable, multiLine, dismissable in [UiObject](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/uiObjectType); at, first, last, nonNull, slice and per-item operations including performActionEach in [UiObjectCollection](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/uiObjectCollectionType)
- `Feature` waitAsync, waitThenClick, waitForStable, waitForStableThenClick, waitForVisible, waitForHidden and clickWhenStableAfter in [Global](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/global)
- `Update` Revised automator.isServiceRunning semantics, auto.setFlags (appWindowsFallback, eventAssistedPolling), auto.registerEvent filters, auto.setWindowFilter object form, auto.state.adoptedByEvent, compass k segments returning null, literal xxxContains matching and collection array wrappers for AutoJs6 6.8.0 accessibility automation; marked methods that may block indefinitely
- `Feature` Documentation for [AI](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ai) / [TTS](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/tts) / [Power Manager](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/powerManager) / [Settings](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/settings) / [Work Manager](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/workManager) / [SysProps](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/sysprops)
- `Feature` Documentation for [YOLO](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/yolo)
- `Feature` Documentation for [Converter](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/cvt) / [Formatter](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/fmt) / [Jsox](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/jsox) / [MediaInfo](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/mediainfo) / [MIME](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/mime) / [NanoID](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/nanoid) / [Pinyin](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/pinyin) / [Pinyin4j](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/pinyin4j) / [SQLite](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/sqlite) / [Zip](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/zip)
- `Update` Revised signatures, overloads, defaults and requirements for global objects, app, automation, device, engines, images, HTTP, tasks, UI and utility modules against AutoJs6 6.8.0 Augmentable API
- `Update` Current APIs for cloned apps, asynchronous screenshots, engine lifecycle events, WorkManager compatibility interfaces, OCR Rapid mode and WebSocket byte strings
- `Update` Refreshed the [Engines](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/engines) API: local Python files start through the independent Python Runtime plugin, without falling back to JavaScript on failure
- `Update` Plugin requirements for barcode, QR code, OCR, OpenCC and OpenCV features
- `Update` Completed barcode, QR code, recorder, context, Shell and runtime sections, revising signatures, return values and requirements against AutoJs6 6.8.0 source
- `Improvement` Unified Markdown API reference formatting, internal type links and version labels, moving old content that cannot be verified from source to [Unverified Content](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/suspicious)
- `Improvement` Unified spacing between CJK text and English, numbers, inline code, links and ASCII symbols
- `Improvement` Full generation of offline HTML, JSON and local search indexes, with repeatable content freshness checks
- `Fix` Incorrect replacement of Markdown includes whose names are prefixes of each other in aggregate pages
